app.name: Syncvault
app.tagline: All your clouds, in sync. Only you hold the key.

auth.privacy: Encrypted on this device. Nobody else can read your files.

tray_notice.title: Tray icon not available
tray_notice.body: Your desktop does not show tray icons. On GNOME, enable the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension. Until then, closing the window minimises Syncvault.

password.title: Create your master password
password.body: This password unlocks Syncvault and encrypts your files. Only you know it.
password.label: Master password
password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A few random words make a strong, memorable password.
password.warning: We can't reset this password. If you lose both it and your recovery key, your encrypted files can't be recovered.

errors.createFailed: Couldn't set up your vault. Please try again.
errors.exists: A vault already exists on this computer. Restart Syncvault to unlock it.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.body: If you forget your master password, this key is the only way back in. Store it somewhere safe and offline, like a password manager or on paper.
recoveryKey.label: Recovery key
recoveryKey.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the key and copy it manually.
recoveryKey.confirm: I have saved my recovery key somewhere safe

done.title: You're set up
done.body: Next, connect a cloud account like Google Drive or OneDrive.

unlock.title: Unlock Syncvault
unlock.body: Enter your master password to start syncing.
unlock.label: Master password
unlock.forgot: Forgot your password? Use your recovery key

errors.wrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again.
errors.noVault: No vault was found. Restart Syncvault to set one up.
errors.corrupt: Your vault file can't be read. Use your recovery key to set a new password.
errors.failed: Couldn't unlock right now. Please try again.

recover.title: Use your recovery key
recover.body: Enter the recovery key you saved when you set up Syncvault, then choose a new master password.

errors.invalidKey: That recovery key isn't valid. Check it for typos.
errors.wrongKey: That recovery key belongs to a different vault.
errors.corrupt: Your vault file can't be read. Move vault.json out of the Syncvault settings folder, then try again.
errors.failed: Couldn't use the recovery key right now. Please try again.

overall.paused: A sync is waiting for your review

demo.notice: Demo data: these folders and accounts are fake. Only visible in development builds.

files.title: Files
files.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} items. Very large folders are cut off for now.

encrypted.title: This folder is encrypted
encrypted.body: Its contents can be shown once your vault is unlocked.

errors.accountNotFound: This account is no longer linked.
errors.rcloneUnavailable: The sync engine isn't running. Try again in a moment.

demo.notice: Demo data: these accounts and files are fake. Only visible in development builds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockHint: Forgets your keys from memory and stops syncing until you unlock again.
